key_insight: AbsorbEvo turns natural-language absorber targets into autonomous design iterations by combining LLM reasoning, physics priors, and simulation feedback.
engineering_relevance: The framework can reduce expert bottlenecks in microwave absorber inverse design by accelerating candidate generation and filtering before costly full-wave simulation.
method: LLM proposes parameter update directions and magnitudes from task goals and search history
Global sampling plus directed increments generate candidates, then a low-cost predictive model ranks them
Top candidates are validated with full-wave simulation and physical checks; successful cases update future search and distilled textual skills
evidence_signal: On AbsorbBench-36 held-out tasks, AbsorbEvo achieved 79.17% task success and a mean best coverage of 0.7816, outperforming a generic agent and random search.
watch_item: Performance depends on the quality of the predictive prior, validity checks, and the transferability of distilled skills to new absorber design tasks.
paper_title: AbsorbEvo: An Agentic Framework for Autonomous Inverse Design of Microwave Absorbers
